locator: A10P1, question and rule-of-thumb/contingent/cause title attributes, with A10C second paragraph as recalled context
interpretation: P1 asks for a report rather than recording an actual answer. Its cause title is a prior condition capable of explaining or partly explaining an event/change; this does not itself identify an actual concrete contributor, complete ground or sufficient reason. The rule title explicitly permits counter-reasons and exceptions. No probability space, sampling rule, frequency or calibrated confidence is supplied.
